Tristana.summary: Her early burst and all-ins punish you before you scale, and her W jump closes the distance you need to kite, forcing trades you cannot win early.

Caitlyn.summary: Her long range lets her poke and zone you off the wave, and her traps plus constant autos make farming and trading hard early.

Draven.summary: His axes out-trade you in most early fights, he chases and punishes misplays, and he snowballs fast from small leads.

Nilah.summary: She thrives in all-ins, exactly where you are weakest early. Her sustain, trading and gap closing make it hard to poke her or escape once she commits.

Kalista.summary: Her constant hops make your Q hard to land, so she dodges most poke while pressuring you and threatening all-ins.

Ashe.summary: Her poke and slows from autos and W make trades hard, she outranges you, and her arrow can stop your engage or escape. Early game is especially dangerous; play safe, dodge with E, and take short trades while her W is down.

MissFortune.summary: Her Q and W poke and sustained damage limit safe trading, and her ultimate punishes poor positioning. Reposition with E and take short trades while her Q and W are on cooldown.

Smolder.summary: Not very dangerous since he lacks extreme poke or sustain, but his mobility and burst punish misplacement. Keep trades short and dodge his burst with E.

Vayne.summary: Early trades are fairly safe. Watch her tumble and condemn, avoid unwanted trades with E, and keep distance until you have items, since she scales well.

Jhin.summary: His Q and W poke is annoying but predictable because of his fixed attack speed. His ultimate punishes poor positioning, but you can trade safely by repositioning with E.

Lucian.summary: His burst, mobility and auto resets shred your shield and health, and his dash makes safe engages almost impossible. Play very carefully, save E to dodge his key spells, and wait for mistakes before longer trades.

Twitch.summary: His early presence is weak, and you can attack safely while he is stealthed since he needs time to react. Respect his ultimate later in fights.

KogMaw.summary: His attacks are slow and predictable, so short trades are easy, but do not let him attack freely with W active. His artillery is slow and dodgeable with E; play aggressively only while tracking his cooldowns and jungle support.

Jinx.summary: Her range and rocket and Zap poke make engaging costly, her ultimate punishes low health, and she snowballs late. Be patient, use E to reposition, keep trades short, and only go aggressive with a wave or cooldown advantage.

Aphelios.summary: His range and constant poke make trading nearly impossible, and he outscales you even if you play well early. Play very safe, use E only for secure repositioning, and wait for mistakes.

Sivir.summary: Her wave clear and spell shield make trades awkward, but her lane damage is low. Keep trades short and reposition with E; she becomes more dangerous later with sustained damage and her ultimate.

Samira.summary: Early game is fairly safe if you keep distance and dodge her dash and poke with E. The danger is when her style is stacked and she ults close to you; press when her Q and dash are down.

Xayah.summary: Her poke and feather zones make trading risky. Keep trades short, dodge with E, and respect her feather recall combo when many feathers are down.

Corki.summary: His poke is predictable and easy to dodge with E, and his mana and cooldowns give you trade windows. His range and scaling grow later, but it stays manageable with good spacing.

Kaisa.summary: Early game is fairly safe if you dodge her Q poke and passive stacks with E. Once she has items, her ultimate plus burst makes positioning crucial; avoid long duels while her cooldowns are up.

Varus.summary: His poke is slow and predictable, so you can trade and move freely. Keep distance from his ultimate root and use E to reposition.

Yunara.summary: Her on-hit stacking damage makes her vulnerable to early pressure. Outside her ultimate you can harass her consistently; respect her when she is stacked and uses W or her ultimate.

Ezreal.summary: His Q poke is predictable and easily dodged with E, and his early autos are weak. Keep distance and farm freely with short trades.
